tool_description: PanDermSeg is an open-source skin-lesion segmentation model (PanDerm backbone with UperNet decoder) fine-tuned on the ISIC2018 dermoscopy dataset. It takes a single dermoscopic image and outputs a binary mask (PNG) in which lesion pixels are labeled 1 and background pixels 0.
demo_commands: docker run --rm --gpus all -v /home/yourpath/ISIC2018:/data dermseg python infer.py --input  /data/imagesTs/ISIC_0012373.jpg --output /data/out/ISIC_0012373_pred.png --size 224

input.description: Absolute path to the dermoscopic image (PNG/JPG).

output.description: Destination path for the predicted mask (PNG).

mask_png.description: Path to the PNG segmentation mask (2-class, single-channel).
